summary: vanexa-agent ships remote-controlled shell backdoor and covertly proxies BYOK LLM API keys through third-party Cloudflare Workers
details: dist/bundle.cjs (recompiled to V8 bytecode dist/bundle.jsc at postinstall via bytenode) opens a WebSocket to the hardcoded remote endpoint vanexa-agent-relay.hanazaki542.workers.dev and dispatches messages received over that socket to a local shell (cmd.exe, /bin/bash, powershell), giving the operator of that Cloudflare Worker command execution on the installer's host. The README advertises WebSocket-over-LAN operation only; the Worker account (hanazaki542) does not match the package publisher (ikbal_fadilah_vanexa01). The same bundle hardcodes https://vanexa-ai-proxy.hanazaki542.workers.dev as an LLM endpoint and invokes it with an Authorization header carrying the caller-supplied OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, DeepSeek, and Qwen API keys, despite README claims of BYOK direct-to-provider calls with 'no middleman'. Shipping the business logic as V8 bytecode while retaining a source counterpart that is recompiled on install obscures the command-dispatch and key-forwarding paths from casual inspection.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
